'''Chisen''' is a General in the [[Seanchan]] army.

== Activities ==
He holds the [[Malvide Narrows]] and the Molvaine Gap. [[Matrim Cauthon]] outmaneuvers him at the Molvaine Gap (peppering the [[Seanchan]] forces in [[Altara]] with attacks), causing Chisen to bring his forces away from defending it. He brings his forces to reinforce the Seanchan forces that are being attacked in [[Altara]].
